metadata.description: This narrative companion is a status-preserving guide to the technical ECT preprint. It explains the supplied Euclidean-condensate branches, conditional Lorentzian and gravity-completion routes, quantum and open-system structures, galactic and cosmological diagnostics, scoped negative results, and explicit Open owners. It does not present model-internal algebra, a phenomenological fit, an imported benchmark, or reproduction of an external result as a first-principles derivation of physical ECT ownership. The companion follows the preprint's Level A, Level B, Level C, and Open hierarchy and routes readers to the technical derivations and reproducibility owners.
metadata.title: Euclidean Condensate Theory: A Narrative Companion — Conditional Routes from the Φ-Medium to Lorentzian Kinematics, Gravity, Quantum Structures, and Observational Programmes
